method: Surface records were confirmed from files listed in the row 020 FULL_READ_MANIFEST. The generated all-surface structural inventory was used only for navigation.
limitation_statement: This file is a surface-specific active-code Atlas slice, not acceptance of the generated all-surface active-code Atlas as semantic truth.
surface_limitation: This pass adjudicates transform-boundary proof for selected native financial/event calendar reference, projection, operational, and calendar-feed files. It does not adjudicate donor event-store/event-ingestion service implementation, live calendar/network fetches, candidate formation, capital sizing, or runtime trading behaviour.

records.title: Native financial-calendar files exclude donor event service and runtime owners
adjudication_notes: The new Tier A family parses selected native financial/event calendar files and rejects donor event-store/event-ingestion service imports and runtime owner imports.

The same family rejects recreation of donor event-store/ingestion service symbols such as EventStoreService, EventIngestionService, EventStoreQuery, LiveEventStore, normalise_event_ingestion, and build_live_event_snapshot.
Targeted proof passed without source repair; the transform-required donor cluster was represented as a boundary guard, not imported as native runtime behaviour.
non_claims: Does not prove donor event-store or event-ingestion service behaviour.
Does not upgrade the whole 5.4 surface to implemented.
Does not authorise live calendar/network fetches, candidate formation, broker/order, capital sizing, risk-policy, dependency, or runtime trading behaviour.
